2609.27564.title: TNLearn: An Open Source Python Package for Task-based Neurons
2609.27564.paper_summary: The brain does not rely on a single type of neuron to perform all kinds of tasks; instead, it designs different neurons for different tasks. The concept of task-based neurons represents a paradigm shift compared to task-based architectures. It argues that solving a specific problem requires customized neurons, as task-based neurons capture useful prior knowledge from task-related data. To facilitate the use of task-based neurons in scientific research and industrial applications, we introduce TNLearn, an open-source Python package that provides automated construction of task-based neurons and networks, enabling smooth training of task-based networks. Comprehensive documentation, including technical exposition, API reference, and representative examples, is available online. TNLearn is open-sourced at https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn and has become a PyTorch ecosystem project.
2609.27564.paper_summary_zh: 大腦並不依賴單一類型的神經元來執行各種任務；相反，它為不同的任務設計不同的神經元。以任務為基礎的神經元概念代表了一種與以任務為基礎的架構相比的範式轉變。它主張解決特定問題需要定制的神經元，因為以任務為基礎的神經元能夠從與任務相關的數據中捕捉有用的先驗知識。為了促進在科學研究和工業應用中使用以任務為基礎的神經元，我們介紹了 TNLearn，一個開源的 Python 套件，提供自動構建以任務為基礎的神經元和網絡的功能，使得以任務為基礎的網絡的訓練變得順利。全面的文檔，包括技術說明、API 參考和代表性範例，均可在線獲得。TNLearn 的開源地址為 https://github.com/NewT123-WM/tnlearn，並已成為 PyTorch 生態系統的一部分。
